source: Original AI-generated anatomical surface for Moč & Forma
method: Image generation on an original front/back rest-pose render of the existing CC0 athlete. A fully clothed medical training mannequin with an opaque anatomical-print surface and dark shorts; no third-party reference pixels were used.

projection.layout: Front left, back right; transparent background

use: Illustrative muscle fibres and fascia. Active muscle areas are selected by the existing anatomy map, not inferred from image colours. Not individual medical imaging or a body composition estimate.
posters: All 131 exercise posters and body-anatomy.webp are rendered from the same scene and surface by scripts/render-exercise-posters.mjs with POSTER_WITH_BODY=1.
